HiAppEvent
故障检测
性能监控
调试工具
hilog
如何使用HiLog打印和管理应用日志？
如何检测和订阅应用崩溃事件（JS Crash、Cpp Crash）？
如何检测应用冻屏（AppFreeze）和资源泄漏问题？
如何使用HiTraceMeter进行性能跟踪分析？
如何使用HiTraceChain实现跨线程/跨进程调用链跟踪？
如何订阅系统事件（启动耗时、滑动丢帧、CPU高负载等）？
如何使用HiChecker检测线程耗时和资源泄漏？
如何使用HiCollie监控业务线程卡死卡顿？
如何实现应用的错误管理和自动恢复？
如何使用hdc、hilog、hitrace等调试命令工具？
当应用出现崩溃、冻屏、资源泄漏等稳定性问题时使用本Kit的故障检测能力
通过订阅各类系统事件（崩溃事件、冻屏事件、资源泄漏事件等），开发者可以获取故障现场信息，精准定位问题根因
当需要进行性能优化、功耗分析或运行时监控时使用本Kit
HiTraceMeter可用于性能追踪分析，HiLog用于流水日志记录，HiAppEvent用于事件打点和上报，方便构建端侧APM系统进行线上质量监控
集成应用崩溃上报并订阅 JS/Native 崩溃事件 / Integrate app crash reporting and subscribe to JS/native crash events
记录启动耗时和页面打开耗时用于性能优化 / Record app launch time and page open latency for performance tuning
追踪页面滑动掉帧和界面卡顿问题 / Track scroll frame drops and UI jank issues
监控 CPU 过高、内存异常和资源泄漏 / Monitor high CPU usage, memory anomalies, and resource leaks
用 HiLog 输出分级日志并排查线上问题 / Use HiLog to emit leveled logs and troubleshoot production issues
用 HiTraceMeter 标记关键代码段分析耗时 / Mark critical code sections with HiTraceMeter to analyze execution time
给跨线程或跨进程调用加链路追踪 / Add call-chain tracing across threads or processes
订阅应用冻屏、卡死和主线程阻塞事件 / Subscribe to app freeze, hang, and main-thread blocking events
使用 HiChecker 检查耗时操作和线程违规 / Use HiChecker to detect slow operations and thread violations
用 HiCollie 监控业务线程超时和长时间阻塞 / Use HiCollie to monitor business-thread timeouts and long blocking
上报性能事件到 HiAppEvent 便于分析告警 / Report performance events to HiAppEvent for analysis and alerts
定位点击无响应、渲染慢和交互延迟 / Diagnose unresponsive taps, slow rendering, and interaction latency
do_not_use_when: 需求是编写自动化测试、单元测试、UI测试或测试框架集成，应改用 test-kit / The task is to write automated tests, unit tests, UI tests, or integrate a testing framework; use test-kit instead

需求是实现无障碍能力如读屏、语义辅助、焦点导航或辅助功能适配，应改用 accessibility-kit / The task is to implement accessibility features such as screen reader support, semantic assistance, focus navigation, or accessibility adaptation; use accessibility-kit instead

需求是做界面布局、组件样式、交互动效或视觉规范设计，而不是埋点、日志或性能跟踪，应改用 ui-design-kit / The task is about UI layout, component styling, interaction effects, or visual design rather than instrumentation, logging, or performance tracing; use ui-design-kit instead
需求是处理日期日程、提醒或日历数据读写，应改用 calendar-kit / The task is to handle schedules, reminders, or calendar data read/write; use calendar-kit instead
需求是获取天气数据、天气服务接入或天气展示，应改用 weather-service-kit / The task is to obtain weather data, integrate weather services, or display weather information; use weather-service-kit instead
需求是做多语言、本地化资源、翻译或区域格式适配，应改用 localization-kit / The task is localization, translated resources, or locale-specific formatting adaptation; use localization-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成可用的 HarmonyOS Performance Analysis Kit/DFX 相关 API 或命令行工具环境 / The project has the required HarmonyOS Performance Analysis Kit/DFX APIs or command-line tooling available
若采用系统事件订阅或故障订阅，应用入口、订阅代码及相关能力声明已正确配置 / If using system event or fault subscriptions, the app entry, subscription code, and related capability declarations are correctly configured
若使用 hdc、hilog、hitrace、hiperf 等工具，设备已连接且开发调试环境可访问 / If using hdc, hilog, hitrace, hiperf, or similar tools, a device is connected and the development debugging environment is accessible
待分析的应用构建版本已包含对应日志、事件打点或跟踪埋点代码 / The target app build already includes the relevant logging, event instrumentation, or tracing calls
inputs: 应用源码文件或 C_C++ 源码文件 / application source files or C/C++ source files
事件名、日志标签或跟踪任务名 / event names, log tags, or trace task names
故障类型或性能问题类型 / fault type or performance issue category
订阅回调、过滤条件或事件参数 / subscription callbacks, filter conditions, or event parameters
设备日志、命令输出或现场信息 / device logs, command output, or captured diagnostic context

postconditions.statement: 已在代码或脚本中加入至少一种性能分析能力调用，如 HiLog、HiAppEvent、HiTraceMeter、HiTraceChain、HiChecker、HiDebug 或相关 DFX 工具使用 / At least one performance-analysis capability invocation has been added in code or scripts, such as HiLog, HiAppEvent, HiTraceMeter, HiTraceChain, HiChecker, HiDebug, or related DFX tool usage
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code/scripts to invoke at least one Performance Analysis Kit capability such as HiLog, HiAppEvent, HiTraceMeter, HiTraceChain, HiChecker, HiDebug, or a related DFX command?

postconditions.statement: 若目标是事件订阅或故障检测，已新增对应订阅注册与回调处理逻辑 / If the goal is event subscription or fault detection, the edits include the corresponding subscription registration and callback handling logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the requested task involves subscribing to events or detecting faults, do the edits include subscription registration plus callback or handler logic for those events?

postconditions.statement: 若目标是日志或链路跟踪，新增代码包含清晰的标签、事件名或跟踪区间边界，便于后续分析 / If the goal is logging or tracing, the new code includes clear tags, event names, or trace span boundaries to support later analysis
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task is about logging or tracing, do the edits show meaningful log tags, event names, or explicit trace begin/end boundaries rather than vague placeholders?
